$schema: See patches/README.md for the field reference.
name: play-store-source
title: Play Store install source
summary: Reports the app as installed from the Play Store, so the bundled Play licensing check accepts a re-signed build.

hooks.why: PackageManager.getInstallerPackageName is the pre-API-30 form of the same question, still read by the Sentry and AppsFlyer builds and by the obfuscated SDK code in lin0/j65. Same answer, otherwise those readers keep reporting a side-load.

The gate that decides whether the app runs: LicenseClient.performLocalInstallerCheck compares this exact string against com.android.vending and ends on the licensing error dialog otherwise. The remaining sites only keep the answer consistent (in-app review, install-source telemetry, attribution).
AppsFlyer reads the initiating installer next to the installing one; a patched install must not be attributed to an unknown store.

InstallSourceTelemetry sends the numeric package source as an analytics property. 2 is PACKAGE_INSTALLER_PACKAGE_SOURCE_STORE; without it the spoofed installer name sits next to a source value that still says side-loaded.
